summary: Backend engineer with seven years building **payment and data platforms** in TypeScript and Go. Comfortable owning a service from design review to on-call, and happiest where reliability work pays for itself in fewer incidents.

bullets: Rebuilt the settlement pipeline as an event-driven service in Go, cutting end-of-day reconciliation from **4 hours to 25 minutes**.
Led the move from cron jobs to a queue-backed scheduler with idempotent retries; payment-related incidents fell **60%** in two quarters.
Introduced OpenTelemetry tracing across 14 services and wrote the runbooks the on-call rotation now uses.
Designed the public REST API for the reporting product (TypeScript, PostgreSQL), serving 3,000 customer integrations.
Cut p95 query latency from 1.8 s to 300 ms by reworking indexes and adding a read replica for heavy reports.
Mentored three junior engineers through their first production launches.
Built internal tooling in Node.js for test-data generation, used by every QA team in the company.
Containerized the legacy monolith and wrote its first Kubernetes deployment manifests.

projects.name: pg-shadow
projects.description: Replays production query traffic against a candidate schema to catch slow migrations before they ship.
